description: Fetch a judicial financial disclosure by disclosure_id from courtlistener_search_financial_disclosures. Returns metadata, counts and typed line items with coded values decoded to dollar ranges. Select categories or omit for all. Oversized selections return outline then page responses; continue retrieval.next_cursor as cursor with the unchanged ID/categories selection until null. Large individual row fields remain recoverable through text_chunks.

categories.description: Line-item categories to select. Omit for all. Oversized selections page; keep this selection unchanged while following cursor.

cursor.description: Retrieval next_cursor from the previous response. Repeat the original ID and sections/categories selection unchanged; omit to start.

disclosure_id.description: Financial disclosure ID — the disclosure_id field from a courtlistener_search_financial_disclosures result.

name: courtlistener_get_financial_disclosure

items.description: A continuing agreement or arrangement (Part VIII); omitted partial strings remain reachable through retrieval.

date.description: Date of the agreement as filed.

parties_and_terms.description: Parties to and terms of the agreement.

redacted.description: True if the source row was partially redacted.

counts.description: Count of line items in each disclosure category.

non_investment_incomes.description: Number of reported non-investment income sources.

spouse_incomes.description: Number of reported spouse income sources.

items.description: A debt or liability (Part VII); omitted partial strings remain reachable through retrieval.

redacted.description: True if the source row was partially redacted.

value_range.description: Value of the debt as a dollar range; empty if none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_cursor`: Retrieval cursor is malformed, out of range or belongs to another request. `stale_cursor`: The normalized selected source changed since the previous page. `not_found`: Disclosure ID does not exist in CourtListener. `rate_limited`: 429 from CourtListener, or no request slot opened within the wait budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A reported gift (Part VI); omitted partial strings remain reachable through retrieval.

value.description: Reported dollar value; empty if not stated.

has_been_extracted.description: True if line items were parsed from the PDF; category arrays are empty when false.

items.description: An investment holding (Part VII); omitted partial strings remain reachable through retrieval.

description.description: Name of the holding (e.g. "Citibank, N.A. Accounts").

income_range.description: Income during the reporting period as a dollar range (e.g. "$1 - $1,000"); empty if none.

redacted.description: True if the source row was partially redacted.

transaction.description: Transaction during the period (e.g. "Buy", "Sold"); empty if none.

transaction_date.description: Transaction date as filed; empty if none.

transaction_gain_range.description: Gain realized on the transaction as a dollar range; empty if none.

transaction_partner.description: Identity of the transaction partner; empty if none.

transaction_value_range.description: Transaction value as a dollar range; empty if none.

value_method.description: Valuation method (e.g. "Cash/market value", "Appraisal"); empty if none.

value_range.description: Gross value at period end as a dollar range (e.g. "$250,001 - $500,000"); empty if none.

is_amended.description: True if this filing is an amendment.

kind.description: 'full' carries a small selected record; 'outline' pages the section catalog; 'page' carries typed rows and field-path text chunks. Filing identity and counts remain present.

items.description: The filer's non-investment income (Part II); omitted partial strings remain reachable through retrieval.

amount.description: Amount as filed — usually a dollar string (e.g. "$10,116.00").

redacted.description: True if the source row was partially redacted.

source_type.description: Source and type of the income.

page_count.description: Page count of the source filing; null if not recorded.

pdf_url.description: URL to the source disclosure PDF; null if unavailable.

person_id.description: Person ID of the filer — pass to courtlistener_get_judge; null if absent.

items.description: An outside position held by the filer (Part I); omitted partial strings remain reachable through retrieval.

redacted.description: True if the source row was partially redacted.

items.description: A travel/event reimbursement (Part IV); omitted partial strings remain reachable through retrieval.

redacted.description: True if the source row was partially redacted.

source.description: Who provided the reimbursement (e.g. a law school).

report_type.description: Report type (Nomination, Initial, Annual, Final, or Unknown).

retrieval.description: Caller retrieval completion, separate from upstream source completion.

next_cursor.description: Continue with cursor and the same ID/selection; null when this fetched view is exhausted.

ranges.description: Absolute source coordinates; merge typed rows by index rather than appending duplicates.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the normalized unsliced selected view.

total.description: Length of the complete normalized collection or text field.

text_chunks.description: Text omitted from partial rows/metadata, recoverable exactly using the matching ranges.

path.description: JSON Pointer of the original string field or string-array element.

text.description: Unescaped normalized substring, matching its code_points range.

retrieval_notice.description: How to continue bounded retrieval using the unchanged ID and selection.

sections.description: Category catalog in declared order, with paged metadata fields. Follow retrieval.next_cursor to finish the catalog and retrieve data.

items.description: A retrievable category (by name) and its serialized byte size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

items.description: The filer's spouse income (Part III); omitted partial strings remain reachable through retrieval.

redacted.description: True if the source row was partially redacted.

source_type.description: Source and type of the spousal income.

title: Get Financial Disclosure
